title: agropyron orientale subsp. lanuginosum
intro: Agropyron orientale subsp. lanuginosum, commonly known as Dune Brome, is a type of grass native to the coastal regions of the Mediterranean. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving breathing. The therapeutic actions of Dune Brome include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which help in soothing coughs and relieving congestion. The bioactive constituents of Dune Brome include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
